name: threat-level-escalation
intent: Five discrete threat plates with unique clip geometry escalate to maximal CRITICAL (non-strobing).

reducedMotion.behaviour: Jump directly to LEVEL 5 CRITICAL plate

waveC: Discrete plate geometry per level; CRITICAL halftone maximal without strobing
acceptance: Five discrete threat plates escalate LOW → CRITICAL at 200ms per step
Each level uses unique frozen plate geometry (rect, angled, hatch, ticks, halftone)
CRITICAL maximal halftone plate holds without strobing
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) jumps to LEVEL 5 CRITICAL immediately
No network; plates clipped to host
